Revision hashes ignore capture time, so identical content means no new revision.

## Still unverified
Edited messages still need a test on real Hermes data.

conversations.title: Draft release notes, then switch models

content.text: Draft release notes for the browsing slice.

Added: conversation list with keyword search.
Added: transcript reader with per-path reading position.
Fixed: unknown activity no longer sorts as recent.
Model changed from a fast tier to a higher reasoning tier.
Now tighten the wording and keep it under 80 words.
Browse and search imported conversations, read long sessions with a collapsible outline, and keep your place on each branch. Unknown activity times now sort last instead of appearing recent.
You are helping plan a report. Keep answers short.
Prefer tables for comparisons.
Outline the evaluation report. What sections do we need?
List the decisions a reader makes, then one section per decision.

# Report outline

## Summary
One paragraph on what was compared and the headline result.

## Method
Tasks, configurations, repetitions, and judges.

### Judges
Each criterion scored 0 to 1; unjudged stays blank.

## Results
A task by configuration grid with quality, tokens, cost, and time in separate columns.

## Limitations
What the sample does not cover.
Model changed from the fast tier to the deep tier.
Check how long the results table would be for 12 tasks and 3 configurations.
I'll compute the grid size.
{"command": "python3 -c 'print(12*3)'"}

## Table size
36 cells, so the grid fits on one screen at desktop width.

## Recommendation
Group rows by task family and keep configurations as columns.
Thinking level raised to high.
Earlier turns were summarized by the harness to fit the context window.
Good. Draft the Limitations section.

## Limitations

### Sample
Twelve tasks from one person's history.

### Judges
Deterministic checks only; no model judges yet.

### Cost
List prices, not actual charges.
